status: Complete source-only audit; no runtime or new Java equality credit

original_facts.fact: TS_WEEK selects period_suffix TS_HOUR. TIME_SUFFIXES_2_MULT maps a week to7*24*60*60seconds and an hour to60*60seconds, so entries=span/period is168 for that original selected span.

The original selected week is a current-clock interval: SystemTime current time plus period offset, rounded up to an hourly boundary, then minus the7-day span. It is not seven UTC calendar files ending at the end of a selected date. A weekday/time offset is permitted by the original panel.

Each period independently invokes the original Date reader, selecting payload download3 and upload1. It separately queries overall-period totals. Pixel-width chunks can accumulate zero-width hourly buckets or repeat a value across multiple pixels; display data is power-of-two scaled then int-converted.

Original time labels use default-zone SimpleDateFormat (dd HH:mm for TS_WEEK); two payload colors, legend hover/visibility, monitor-width buffer and byte formatter are panel presentation choices, not the new fixed UTC axis contract.

deliberate_native_scope: Append a WeekHourly renderer mode consuming exactly seven already accepted UTC daily snapshots. Map bucket24*dayIndex+hour directly to days[dayIndex].snapshot.hours[hour], download3/upload1, without sums/divisions, clock reads or file requests.
Both selected UTC modes retain the same seven-row daily table. Daily totals remains default; mode is an in-memory graph preference preserved only for that View lifetime.

Every point retains explicit UTC date and hour0..23. Unknown hours/day snapshots are gaps; knownzero and signed extrema remain actual scalar facts. Only adjacent known hour buckets connect, including genuine hour23-to-next-day-hour0 adjacency, with no bridge through a missing bucket.
Reuse copied immutable scalar frames and finite signed geometry. Sparse date+hour ticks must distinguish days; full exact bucket labels/tooltips remain independent of width.
Mode changes preserve date/session/request/accepted snapshot and emit no reads; hidden/minimized changes defer chart facts, tooltips and model mutation. Reentry/deletion admission stays guarded.

Original rolling/hour-rounding/current-clock/local-zone/pixel-merging/global-owner/cache/writer semantics remain excluded. A fixed selected168-hour display does not establish original week graph or whole-period-total equality.
